 OUR CULTURE: At Base Culture, we believe in the primal integrity of each of our delectable creations. Grain free. Gluten Free. Dairy free. Non-GMO, Soy free. and Paleo Certified. We’ve re-imagined our old favorite treats (brownies and almond butter, anyone?) and regular meal staples, in their purest, healthier form, using only ingredients that fuel our body. And, we’ve worked hard to create an eclectic array of options, so your paleo snacks and indulgences can always feel brand new. 
 KETO FRIENDLY BREAD: Almond butter, arrowroot and potato flour along with golden flax seed meal and honey give our keto sandwich bread a nutty-sweet taste that can’t be beat! Now, taste is important, but it is our belief that so is texture. Try it toasted or build a BLT, the options are endless! But most importantly the days of worrying about poor tasting gluten free bread falling apart in your hands are over. 
 COMMONLY ASKED QUESTIONS: New to the paleo diet? Let us do our best to explain our keto bread. Our Sandwich Bread (and every other product we make) is made out of seeds and nuts and sweetened with honey. There are no wheats or grains, or artificial ingredients in any of our items. Yes it is already baked, no further cooking is needed. Feel free to warm it up in the oven or toaster if you'd like. Each loaf comes pre-sliced to allow for fast sandwich making. Contains no peanuts. 
 HOW TO STORE OUR BREAD: We HIGHLY recommend storing our keto bread in the freezer and taking out only what you will eat. Our bread is created with only 100% all natural ingredients and ZERO preservatives to provide you with the best gluten free bread option possible. We take pride in providing quality work boots with premium materials and purpose-built construction for various worksite needs. The Georgia Boot AMP LT composite toe low heel logger is great for very rugged jobsite environments. It is a defined heel work boot built with a Goodyear welt construction, chemical and abrasion resistant SRP leather upper, and an oil and slip resisting rubber lug outsole. The upper on this durable waterproof work boot also features easy grip panels for an easy pull on and a removable brush guard kiltie that protects your laces from brush and debris. The Counter Lock system on the rear of the boot prevents heel slippage. The interior is equipped with performance features to keep your feet comfortable all shift long. Armed with the Georgia Waterproof system, your feet will stay dry when working in wet conditions. A soft lining protects the waterproof membrane. Your feet will rest upon the AMP LT memory foam insole, providing customized cushioning. The comfort footbed is removable for easy cleaning and replacement. This composite toe work boot features an Ergo-Fit toe cap, designed to match the contours of your feet. This lends to a better range of motion for your toes, while still maintaining the ASTM F2413 impact and compression standards for protective toe work boots. The foundation of this men's low heel logger boot includes a steel shank for additional arch support and stability, a cushioning EVA midsole and an EH rated rubber outsole. The oil and slip resistant outsole meets ASTM F2413 electrical hazard rating for safety toe work boots.
